answer_1.quote: Synchronized video storytelling aims to generate synchronized narrations for videos... Our framework generates coherent video stories with appropriate word sequence lengths ...
answer_1.outputs: Synchronized narrations (story) for each video clip

answer_2.quote: we evaluate the generated narrations with NLP metrics such as BLEU, METEOR, and CIDEr. We also propose reference-free metrics ... EMScore, Info Sim, Info Diverse, Word Length, Script Label, Intra-Repetition.

answer_3.quote: When generating stories controlled by a predefined storyline, we utilize GPT-4 to assess the controllable accuracy of the script labels.
methods: Prompt-based evaluation of script label controllability using GPT-4

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations as well on three metrics: (1) Visual Relevance ... (2) Attractiveness ... (3) Coherence ... All metrics are rated from 0 to 3. We randomly sample 30 stories and ask 13 advertisers to conduct the evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Advertisers rated each generated story on Visual Relevance, Attractiveness, and Coherence using a 0‑3 scale.
